name: Palak Shorba
steps: Wash spinach in several changes of water and discard tough stems. Chop spinach, onion, ginger and garlic separately; grit left in the leaves will spoil the smooth soup.
Heat ghee and sizzle cumin. Soften onion for 5 minutes without deep browning, then stir in ginger and garlic for 1 minute. Add spinach and stir until wilted.
Add water, salt and pepper and simmer uncovered for 5–6 minutes until leaves are tender. Let the mixture cool until safe for your blender; blend in small batches without sealing hot steam inside.
Return to the pan and heat gently. Stir in cream without a hard boil; the shorba should flow freely and coat a spoon lightly. Taste and serve hot.
notes: Base recipe for 4 adults. Cooking times are estimates; follow the texture and doneness cues. Jain suitability follows your saved ingredient choices.
